Backend: Express API (`backend/index.js`); routes `backend/src/routes/`, controllers `backend/src/controllers/`, repositories `backend/src/repositories/`. `RepositoryFactory` switches JSON/Mongo. Menu uploads use multer `upload.single("image")`. Frontend: React (`frontend/src/`); admin `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`; API client `frontend/src/lib/api.js` uses `fetch`, `credentials: 'include'`, detects `FormData`, unwraps responses. Image storage: local/Cloudinary; config `backend/.env`, examples `backend/.env.examples`.

Read `backend/src/routes/*.js`, `backend/src/controllers/*`, `backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`, `frontend/src/lib/api.js`, `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`, `backend/.env.examples`, and `./backend/AGENTS.md`, `./frontend/AGENTS.md`. Tests: `backend/src/__tests__`, `supertest`, app export `backend/index.js`; use `createTestAdmin`, `getAuthHeaders`, `RepositoryFactory`. Prefer repository factory for data operations.

(do not set `Content-Type` manually). The frontend must not set `Content-Type` header explicitly when sending FormData (the client `api.js` handles this). Setting `Content-Type` manually will break boundary generation. Cookie-first auth: never rely on localStorage tokens in productio
